title: WALTEUR Cost Budget
description: Per-request / per-run / per-LLM-task spend ceilings for an application that spends money to serve a request — paid cloud-provider calls and/or LLM completions. CONSTRAINT: an app that calls an LLM or a paid cloud API with NO declared budget is unbounded slop. At least one of `units` (cloud/compute cost ceilings per request or per run) or `llm` (per-task LLM spend + token ceilings) MUST be declared; declare both when the app does both. Money is a first-class budget, not an afterthought.

units.description: One entry per billable unit of work (e.g. 'api-request', 'batch-job', 'image-resize'). Each declares the USD ceiling for ONE request OR ONE run — exactly one of the two must be set.

max_usd_per_request.description: Maximum US dollars this unit may cost to serve a single request. REQUIRED when the unit is request-scoped. Mutually exclusive with max_usd_per_run.

max_usd_per_run.description: Maximum US dollars this unit may cost for a single run (job/batch invocation). REQUIRED when the unit is run-scoped. Mutually exclusive with max_usd_per_request.

llm.description: One entry per LLM-backed feature (e.g. 'summarize', 'chat', 'classify'). Each declares the per-task USD ceiling AND the per-task token ceiling — both are mandatory so a single task cannot silently blow either money or context.

max_usd_per_task.description: Maximum US dollars this feature may spend on LLM calls for a single task. REQUIRED and non-null.

max_tokens.description: Maximum total tokens (prompt + completion) this feature may consume for a single task. REQUIRED and non-null.
